filer: SPIRIT OF AMERICA INVESTMENT FUND INC

cover_fields.explanatoryNotes: Spirit of America Utilities Fund ("SOAUX"), launched in February 2023, is one of six (6) funds under the Spirit of America Investment Fund, Inc. ("SOA'" or the "Fund") family of funds, the earliest of which date back to 1998. Spirit of America Management Corp (the "Adviser") serves as the investment adviser to SOA. The Adviser utilizes several, third-party proxy service providers to assist it in fulfilling its proxy voting obligations. The Adviser has determined that, due to an inadvertent coding error, SOAUX had not properly set up its proxy voting procedures with its third-party proxy service providers. As a result, it appears that 16 proxies for SOAUX during the reporting period were not voted. The error has been corrected and the proper proxy voting process for SOAUX has been established. The Adviser and SOAUX will adhere to the proxy voting process to ensure that this issue is not repeated.
